nodes.text: Wardens' post. Fourteen miles of road, one lamp, two moods. Which do you need?
Us, the lamps, and the fences, in that order. Brigands keep the toll bends, wolves keep the trail. I keep the ledger even.
Always. Tonight it's the same as every night — hold fourteen miles with six hands. When something's stirring out there, come ask me and I'll point you at it.
A cart with bells went up the road this morning and stopped. Friendly, by the ledger. Go quick — carts don't keep.
